cases.code:
import random
r = random.Random(33)
n = 250
perm = list(range(1, n)); r.shuffle(perm); lab = [0] + perm
par = [-1] * n
for i in range(1, n): par[lab[i]] = lab[r.randrange(max(0, i - 6), i)]
dem = [r.randint(3, 5) for _ in range(n)]
cap = [r.randint(200, 1250) for _ in range(n)]
cc = [r.randint(0, 10**6) for _ in range(n)]
crit = [r.random() < 0.02 for _ in range(n)]
result = [sol.min_pruning_cost(par, dem, cap, cc, crit, rc, p) for rc, p in ((500, 10**5), (900, 1), (1250, 10**6))]

import random
r = random.Random(34)
n = 250
par = [-1] + [0] * (n - 1)
path = [0] + list(range(n - 1, 0, -1))
for a, b in zip(path, path[1:]): par[b] = a
dem = [r.randint(0, 5) for _ in range(n)]
cap = [0] + [max(0, 1250 - 5 * k + r.randint(-40, 0)) for k in range(1, n)]
cc = [r.randint(0, 1000) for _ in range(n)]
crit = [False] * n
result = [sol.min_pruning_cost(par, dem, [cap[path.index(v)] if v else 0 for v in range(n)], cc, crit, rc, 50) for rc in (100, 400, 1250)]
